text:
The former name was Surat Dental Clinic. The doctor is very skilled. I had problems with crowded teeth, buck teeth, and protruding teeth. Before receiving treatment, I consulted with two or three clinics, but the doctor there recommended seeing Dr. Surat.

In my case, when I was a child, the doctor at the hospital recommended waiting for my bone to stop growing before undergoing jaw surgery and screw fixation. Nowadays, braces can be started from a young age, using jaw expanders to allow the bone to grow as it grows. The doctor explained this to me.

The treatment was performed using a plate for chewing during braces, instead of surgery, which was very comfortable. Thank you very much, doctor.

My first time at this dental clinic was a great experience! The dentist was very gentle and kind, which significantly reduced my fear. The clinic is easy to find using Google Maps.
There's street parking in front of the clinic and across the street. The clinic is clean.
The air conditioning is refreshingly cool, and there's free Wi-Fi.
There's a clean restroom at the back, and an X-ray machine inside.
If you're interested in braces, dentures, extractions, fillings, or teeth cleaning, I highly recommend this place!
